allocation: Local CPU only, one short scalar run per basis; no GPU or cloud call.
native_limit: One SCF iteration, strict native convergence flag retained. Nonconvergence is expected; energies are not scientific measurements.
criteria: Actual scalar orbital counts and shell multiplicities must match; positive finite radii; explicit TZP radial orbitals must match the existing automatic TZP reference. Additional polarization must preserve shared radial functions.
scope: Native basis-generation identity only; no anisotropy, convergence, magnetic-branch or prediction claim.
